allow.reason: The brief asked for columbiasurgery.org's own type, which is Libre Franklin (self-hosted there, not available as a system font). Loaded with display=swap, three weights only, preconnect hints, and a Franklin Gothic/Helvetica fallback stack so text paints before the font arrives. Recorded in site/design.md.
The favicon is an inline SVG data URI and cannot read CSS custom properties; its two literal colours are the Columbia blue token value and white, the same pair the masthead renders from tokens.
